summary: Conservative failures have no common timing and no repeated PPO/critic precursor absent from controls.
Short-horizon actor and policy divergence patterns differ across adverse seeds and do not yield a DRTP-specific precursor.
The frozen mechanism matrix rejects every criterion for a failure-group-conditioned credit mechanism.
Across 88 alarms, 3 are practically beneficial, 1 harmful, and 84 near-zero; no seed-level selector signal is established.
Both fresh five-seed cohorts systematically lose reward and create new catastrophic seeds; counterfactual critic is not a viable intervention.
